risksAndLimits.detail: Final ZIP bytes/SHA, safe extraction, full manifest verification and execution in the newly extracted directory remain parent-owned future checks. The 71/619 result reviewed here is the already executed final working-tree TAP receipt, not a ZIP claim.

Did not review evidence/round16/README.md or PACKAGE_REVIEW.md content because the parent is finalizing them. Future index content is outside this pass; linked files that already exist were checked only for path resolution.

The 72/626 suite, full eight-suite 55/841 browser matrix, 1000+50 and natural measurements, and performance after/current rows retain their input/pre-rollback candidate identities. Post-rollback 19/376 browser and release 71/619 TAP results are separately cited.
Per-version four-seed policy still has seed23757 failing at floor30 after21 deaths; 3/4 completions are not human win probability. Free branches are not additional independent journeys.

Sorting candidate remains withdrawn; native-page tails and software-4K missing effect windows remain unresolved. Logical viewports, injected lifecycle faults and timer residuals are not hardware FPS or physical-device validation.

judgment: No unresolved material contradiction was found in the ten final reviewed documents after the parent corrections. Runtime scope is exactly six files / +3346 bytes; counts, published-versus-candidate identity and relative evidence links are consistent. Proceed to the separate final manifest/ZIP gate; this audit does not preapprove that future artifact.
